result.title: Model- and Layer-Level Closed-Loop Forecasting with SSM-Based Spiking Neural Networks
result.summary: Deep State-Space Models (Deep SSMs) have shown promising performance and computational benefits in processing of time-series data with complex temporal dependencies. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) constitute a biologically inspired class of deep SSMs, where computing blocks communicate through spikes, discrete single-bit events rather than continuous activation functions. A particularly important task in time-series processing is forecasting, i.e. predicting future values of a sequence from past observations alone. However, how to best perform forecasting with SNNs is an open question, where the standard autoregressive nature of the data processing with SNNs requires values that are not available during the forecasting phase. In this article, we address this challenge. We explore two closed-loop forecasting strategies, in which the network's own generated values are fed back into the network as if they were observed past values: (i) model-level and (ii) layer-level closed-loop forecasting. We evaluate these approaches on the ETT-small datasets, a standard benchmark for time-series forecasting, under both spike-based and continuous activation functions. We compare the proposed closed-loop approaches against state-of-the-art methods such as SpaceTime, as well as the zero-masking baseline in S4. Both of the proposed approaches perform comparably to or better than zero-masking with S4, and in most cases match SpaceTime. These findings highlight the trade-off between continuous and low-bit quantized activations, and demonstrate that the proposed Deep SSM architectures provide a competitive framework for forecasting.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究基于状态空间模型的脉冲神经网络（SNN）如何做时间序列预测，提出模型级与层级两种闭环预测策略，将网络自身生成的值回灌为「观测」输入，并在 ETT-small 上比较脉冲激活与连续激活的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 层级闭环把自生成值注入中间层继续前向计算，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的循环更新与再注入方式提供方法线索，可供核查其反馈粒度与误差累积代价。
